import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score, KFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set up paths
input_dir = "./input"
sub_dir = "./submission"

# Create submission directory if needed
os.makedirs(sub_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(input_dir, "train.csv"))
test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(input_dir, "test.csv"))

# Load sample submission for format reference
sample_sub_path = os.path.join(input_dir, "sample_submission.csv")
if os.path.exists(sample_sub_path):
    sample_submission = pd.read_csv(sample_sub_path)
else:
    sample_submission = None

# Define feature columns (exclude Id and Cover_Type)
all_cols = set(train_df.columns)
feature_cols = [c for c in train_df.columns if c != "Id" and c != "Cover_Type"]

# Prepare data
X_train_orig = train_df.drop(columns=["Id", "Cover_Type"]).values.copy()
y_train_labels = train_df["Cover_Type"].values
test_X_orig = (
    test_df.drop(columns=["Id"]) if "Id" in test_df.columns else test_df.values
)

# Convert to float32 for memory efficiency
X_train_orig = X_train_orig.astype("float32")
test_X_orig = test_X_orig.astype("float32")

# Scale features
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_train_orig)
test_X_scaled = scaler.transform(test_X_orig)

# Apply class weight for imbalanced data
classes = np.unique(y_train_labels)
class_counts = np.bincount(y_train_labels)
n_classes = len(classes)
weight_per_class = n_classes / class_counts
sample_weights = weight_per_class[y_train_labels]

# Define LightGBM parameters
lgb_params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": n_classes,
    "metric": "accuracy",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "max_depth": 7,
    "min_child_weight": 10,
    "reg_alpha": 0.01,
    "reg_lambda": 0.01,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "n_estimators": 1000,
    "verbose": -1,
    "random_state": 42,
    "seed": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
}

# Train with class weights
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(**lgb_params)

# Split for final evaluation
X_train_final, X_val_final, y_train_final, y_val_final = train_test_split(
    X_train_scaled,
    y_train_labels,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y_train_labels,
)

# Train on full training set with validation held out
model.fit(
    X_train_final,
    y_train_final,
    eval_set=[(X_train_final, y_train_final), (X_val_final, y_val_final)],
    sample_weight=sample_weights,
    verbose=-1,
)

# Evaluate on held-out validation set (NOT retrained after)
y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val_final)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val_final, y_val_pred)
print(f"Hold-out Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.4f}")

# Generate predictions on test set
y_test_pred = model.predict(test_X_scaled)
test_ids = test_df["Id"].values if "Id" in test_df.columns else range(len(test_df))

# Create submission DataFrame
if sample_submission is not None:
    submission_df = sample_submission.copy()
else:
    submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
        {"Id": test_ids, "Cover_Type": y_test_pred.astype(int)}
    )

# Save submission to correct location
submission_df.to_csv(os.path.join(sub_dir, "submission.csv"), index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")

# Print final validation metric
print(
    f"\nFinal Evaluation Metric (Multi-Class Classification Accuracy): {val_accuracy:.4f}"
)
